name: How do I choose the right size tubular skylight for my room?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size tubular skylight for my room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right tubular skylight size depends on the room's square footage, ceiling height, and desired light level. Generally, smaller rooms like hallways or bathrooms may benefit from a 10-inch diameter, while larger areas such as kitchens or living rooms might require 14-inch or 21-inch units for optimal illumination. An on-site consultation helps determine the best size by evaluating your specific space and lighting goals.
